title: Predicting the unpredictable: the regulatory nature and promiscuity of herbicide cross resistance.
authors: Bobadilla, Lucas K; Tranel, Patrick J
one_liner_zh: 综述利用基因组学（DAP-seq等）和蛋白结构预测/对接方法预测除草剂交叉抗性，涉及TF-DNA调控元件识别，但非核心TF-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: The emergence of herbicide-resistant weeds is a significant threat to modern agriculture. Cross resistance, a phenomenon where resistance to one herbicide confers resistance to another, is a particular concern owing to its unpredictability. Nontarget-site (NTS) cross resistance is especially challenging to predict, as it arises from genes that encode enzymes that do not directly involve the herbicide target site and can affect multiple herbicides. Recent advancements in genomic and structural biology techniques could provide new venues for predicting NTS resistance in weed species. In this review, we present an overview of the latest approaches that could be used. We discuss the use of genomic and epigenomics techniques such as ATAC-seq and DAP-seq to identify transcription factors and cis-regulatory elements associated with resistance traits. Enzyme/protein structure prediction and docking analysis are discussed as an initial step for predicting herbicide binding affinities with key enzymes to identify candidates for subsequent in vitro validation. We also provide example analyses that can be deployed toward elucidating cross resistance and its regulatory patterns. Ultimately, our review provides important insights into the latest scientific advancements and potential directions for predicting and managing herbicide cross resistance in weeds. abstract_zh: 抗除草剂杂草的出现是对现代农业的重大威胁。交叉抗性，即对一种除草剂的抗性同时赋予对另一种除草剂抗性的现象，因其不可预测性而尤为令人担忧。非靶标位点（NTS）交叉抗性尤其难以预测，因为它源于编码不直接涉及除草剂靶标位点酶的基因，且可能影响多种除草剂。基因组学和结构生物学技术的最新进展可能为预测杂草物种中的NTS抗性提供新途径。在本综述中，我们概述了可用的最新方法。我们讨论了利用基因组学和表观基因组学技术（如ATAC-seq和DAP-seq）来识别与抗性性状相关的转录因子和顺式调控元件。酶/蛋白质结构预测和对接分析被讨论为预测除草剂与关键酶结合亲和力的初始步骤，以确定后续体外验证的候选对象。我们还提供了可用于阐明交叉抗性及其调控模式的示例分析。最终，我们的综述为预测和管理杂草中除草剂交叉抗性的最新科学进展和潜在方向提供了重要见解。(c) 2023作者。Pest Management Science由John Wiley & Sons Ltd代表Society of Chemical Industry出版。
